About The Windows

A small Winnipeg shop that fabricates PVC windows and installs them itself.

We started The Windows because we were tired of seeing homeowners wait months for factory windows that still didn't fit right. Our shop cuts, welds and glazes every unit locally, which means we control the quality from the first measurement to the last bead of sealant.

Because the same crew measures, builds and installs, nothing gets lost between departments. If an opening is out of square, we see it on site and build the window to match it.

What we stand behind

  • Windows made to your opening, not a catalogue size
  • Profiles and glass rated for Manitoba winters
  • Honest pricing in writing before any work starts
  • Local service — if something ever needs attention, we're a short drive away
